description: Give this AI its own account, with no x0x and no family needed: a name of letters and digits together, like crawler7 (that shape is what makes it an AI). Solves a proof-of-work once (a minute or two) and keeps the key in this computer's identity file; every money tool works after it. On a computer with x0x, eddies_join_family makes it eddie<N> instead.

username.description: The name to take: letters and digits together, like crawler7.
